A estrutura da Task 1 (≥150 palavras, ~20 min)
: detalhes com números, agrupados de forma lógica.
The graph below shows the percentage of households with internet access in three countries between 2000 and 2020.
Country A 40% → 95% · Country B 20% → 80% · Country C 5% → 45%
The line graph illustrates the proportion of homes with access to the internet in three nations over a twenty-year period, from 2000 to 2020.
Overall, internet access rose considerably in all three countries. Country A had the highest figures throughout the period, while Country C remained the lowest.
The chart shows the amount of money spent on food in four countries in 2020.
The bar chart compares how much was spent on food in four nations in 2020.
The table shows the number of students enrolled in five universities in 2010 and 2020.
The pie charts show the main sources of energy in a country in 1990 and 2020.
The graph shows the average price of a house in London between 1980 and 2020.
Museum A 6.2 · Museum B 4.8 · Museum C 1.1 · Museum D 0.9
Quais são as 2 coisas mais importantes? (sem números!)
Overall, Museum A had 6.2 million visitors and Museum D had 0.9 million.
Overall, Museum A was by far the most visited, while Museums C and D attracted far fewer visitors than the other two.

explanations.general: Correct answer: The bar chart compares the proportion of adults who ride a bicycle weekly across four age groups in 2010 and 2020.

questions.questionText: In Task 1, the overview should explain why the changes happened.

explanations.general: Falso: não explique causas, apenas descreva.

content.text: 1 The table compares enrolment figures at five universities in 2010 and 2020. 2 The pie charts illustrate the main energy sources in a country in 1990 and 2020. 3 The line graph presents the average cost of a house in London over a forty-year period.
A muito à frente dos outros; C e D bem abaixo de A e B.
The bar chart compares the proportion of adults who cycled at least once a week in four age groups in 2010 and 2020.

Overall, cycling was most popular among the youngest adults in both years, and participation rose in most age groups. The most dramatic change was among people aged 60 and over, whose figure nearly doubled.
